title: Register goal_summary in discovery-registration.ts
description: Registers the 'goal_summary' shape in discovery-registration.ts to close the orphaned-capability-goal_summary gap.

changes.anchor:
shapes: 'conceptDbReachable' in config && config.conceptDbReachable === false

      : config.discovery.shapes,
